# Testimonial

`social-proof/testimonial` &middot; section-level &middot; category: social-proof

## Purpose

A customer quote with their name, title and an optional avatar and star rating.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `quote` | text |  |
| `name` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | text |  |
| `avatar` | image { src, alt } |  |
| `rating` | number |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Centered quote with a large quote mark.
- **bar**: Left-aligned quote with an accent bar. Sets `layout: bar`, `align: left`.
- **card**: Centered quote in a bordered card. Sets `frame: card`.
- **tinted**: On the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `layout` | one of `centered`, `bar` | `"centered"` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `frame` | one of `default`, `card`, `tinted` | `"default"` |
| `avatarSize` | length | `"72px"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Text and layout honored. Circular avatar renders square. | Fine. | Text and background swap via dm-* classes on the brand surface or background. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('social-proof/testimonial', {
  "quote": "I have washed this shirt forty times and it just keeps getting softer. Easily the best linen I own.",
  "name": "Priya N.",
  "title": "Verified buyer, Portland",
  "avatar": {
    "src": "https://placehold.co/160x160/png?text=Priya",
    "alt": "Portrait of Priya N."
  },
  "rating": 5
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "social-proof/testimonial",
  "data": {
    "quote": "I have washed this shirt forty times and it just keeps getting softer. Easily the best linen I own.",
    "name": "Priya N.",
    "title": "Verified buyer, Portland",
    "avatar": {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/160x160/png?text=Priya",
      "alt": "Portrait of Priya N."
    },
    "rating": 5
  }
}
```
